title: Application to Replace Permanent Resident Card — I-90

sections.acomodacoes: Part 4 — Accommodations for Individuals With Disabilities

uscis_online.label: USCIS Online Account Number, if any

nome_mudou.label: Has your name legally changed since the issuance of your Permanent Resident Card?

options.nao_aplicavel: N/A — I never received my previous card

nome_cartao_anterior_sobrenome.label: Name exactly as printed on your current card — Family Name

nome_cartao_anterior_nome.label: Name exactly as printed on your current card — Given Name

nome_cartao_anterior_meio.label: Name exactly as printed on your current card — Middle Name

end_correio_cuidados_de.label: Mailing Address — In Care Of Name (if any)

end_correio_rua.label: Mailing Address — Street Number and Name

end_correio_provincia.label: Mailing Address — Province (if outside the U.S.)

end_correio_codigo_postal.label: Mailing Address — Postal Code (if outside the U.S.)

end_fisico_rua.label: Physical Address (if different from mailing) — Street Number and Name

end_fisico_provincia.label: Physical Address — Province (if outside the U.S.)

end_fisico_codigo_postal.label: Physical Address — Postal Code (if outside the U.S.)

classe_admissao.label: Class of Admission
classe_admissao.hint: 3-character code showing the category under which you became a permanent resident (e.g., IR1 = spouse of a U.S. citizen, CR1 = same but conditional). Find it on your current Green Card ("Category" section), your I-485 approval notice, or your immigrant visa.

data_admissao.label: Date of Admission (MM/DD/YYYY)
data_admissao.hint: Date you first became a permanent resident — found on your current Green Card or your I-485 approval notice.

meu_status.label: My status is:
meu_status.hint: "Commuter" is someone who lives outside the U.S. (usually Canada or Mexico) but works in the U.S. as a permanent resident without living there full-time -- uncommon. "Conditional" means permanent residence valid for only 2 years (based on a recent marriage or investment) -- check the validity on your current card. If your card says 10 years and you live in the U.S., you are a "Lawful Permanent Resident".

motivo_secao_a.label: If you are a Permanent Resident or Commuter — reason for application:

options.perdido_roubado_destruido: My previous card was lost, stolen, or destroyed
options.emitido_nao_recebido: My previous card was issued but never received
options.mutilado: My current card has been mutilated
options.erro_dhs: My current card has incorrect data due to DHS error
options.biografia_mudou: My name or other biographic information has legally changed
options.cartao_expirado: My current card has already expired, or will expire within 6 months
options.14anos_expira_apos_16: I have turned 14 and am registering (card expires AFTER age 16)
options.14anos_expira_antes_16: I have turned 14 and am registering (card expires BEFORE age 16)
options.residente_tomando_status_comutante: I am a permanent resident taking commuter status
options.comutante_tomando_residencia: I am a commuter now actually residing in the U.S.
options.convertido_automaticamente: I was automatically converted to permanent resident status
options.outro_edicao_anterior: I have a prior edition of the card, or another reason not listed

motivo_secao_a.hint: Choose the option closest to your situation. The last two options ("I turned 14...") are only for children who already had a Green Card before age 14 and now need an updated photo/signature.

motivo_comutante_local_poe.label: If a commuter now residing in the U.S.: city and state of your Port of Entry (POE)
motivo_comutante_local_poe.hint: Only applies if you chose a commuter option above. "Port of Entry" is the location (city/border crossing) where you regularly enter the U.S. for work.

motivo_secao_b.label: If you are a Conditional Permanent Resident — reason for application:

options.perdido_roubado_destruido: My previous card was lost, stolen, or destroyed
options.emitido_nao_recebido: My previous card was issued but never received
options.mutilado: My current card has been mutilated
options.erro_dhs: My current card has incorrect data due to DHS error
options.biografia_mudou: My name or other biographic information has legally changed

motivo_secao_b.hint: Only shown if your current card says "conditional resident" (2-year validity). Note: if you are trying to REMOVE the conditions on your Green Card (for example, after 2 years of marriage), this is NOT the right form -- that is done through Form I-751, not I-90. Use this section only if your conditional card was lost, stolen, damaged, has a DHS error, or your biographic info changed.

local_aplicou_visto.label: Location where you applied for your immigrant visa or adjustment of status
local_aplicou_visto.hint: City/country of the U.S. consulate where you applied for your immigrant visa, OR city/USCIS office where your adjustment of status (I-485) was filed.

local_emitido_visto.label: Location where your immigrant visa was issued, or the USCIS office where adjustment of status was granted
local_emitido_visto.hint: City/country of the U.S. consulate that issued your immigrant visa, OR the USCIS office that approved your adjustment of status (I-485).

ja_esteve_processo_remocao.label: Have you ever been in exclusion, deportation, or removal proceedings, or been ordered to leave the U.S.?
ja_esteve_processo_remocao.hint: "Removal/deportation proceedings" is the immigration court process that can end in an order to leave the U.S. -- includes immigration court (EOIR) hearings, even if the case was closed or you won. Answer based on your full history, even from years ago. If unsure, confirm with our team before answering -- an incorrect answer here can have serious consequences.

abandonou_status.label: Since becoming a permanent resident, have you ever filed Form I-407 (Abandonment of Status) or been determined to have abandoned your status?
abandonou_status.hint: Form I-407 is used to voluntarily give up a Green Card. "Determined to have abandoned" includes cases where a border officer already decided you lost your status by staying outside the U.S. too long without the right documents (e.g., no Reentry Permit on a long trip). If unsure, confirm with our team.

porto_entrada.label: Port of Entry where you were admitted to the U.S. (if you entered with an immigrant visa)
porto_entrada.hint: The U.S. airport, land border crossing, or seaport where you were officially admitted as a permanent resident for the first time (passport stamp or I-94 record at i94.cbp.dhs.gov).

destino_eua_admissao.label: Destination in the U.S. at time of admission — City and State
destino_eua_admissao.hint: City and state you declared as your U.S. destination when you entered as a permanent resident (may be different from where you live today).

peso.label: Weight in pounds (lb)
peso.hint: Numbers only, e.g. 155. It will be split automatically into the PDF's 3 digit boxes.

etnia.label: Ethnicity
etnia.hint: An official U.S. government category, separate from "race" (next questions) — this only asks whether you identify as Hispanic/Latino, regardless of race. Most non-Hispanic Brazilians select "Not Hispanic or Latino" here.

raca_indigena_americano.label: Race: American Indian or Alaska Native

raca_havaiano_pacifico.label: Race: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

acomodacao_solicitada.label: Are you requesting any accommodation because of a disability?
acomodacao_solicitada.hint: Optional. Requesting an accommodation (e.g., sign language interpreter, Braille) does not affect the review of your case -- it is only to ensure accessibility during the interview/process, if any.

acomodacao_surdo.label: I am deaf or hard of hearing and am requesting an accommodation

acomodacao_surdo_detalhe.label: Describe the accommodation requested (e.g., sign language)

acomodacao_cego.label: I am blind or have low vision and am requesting an accommodation

acomodacao_outra.label: I have another type of disability

acomodacao_outra_detalhe.label: Describe the nature of the disability and the accommodation requested

leu_ingles.label: Applicant's statement

options.leu_ingles: I can read and understand English, and I have read and understood every question and instruction on this application, as well as my answers
options.leu_interprete: The interpreter named in Part 6 read every question and instruction and my answers to me in a language I understand fluently

leu_ingles.hint: If you do not read/understand English fluently, you need an interpreter (see Part 6) to read and translate the form for you before signing -- it is not about everyday spoken English, it is about actually understanding what you are signing.

idioma_interprete.label: In what language did the interpreter read the form to you?

preparador_ajudou.label: Did someone prepare this form for you, at your request and based only on the information you provided?
preparador_ajudou.hint: Refers to someone who filled out the form FOR you (e.g., consultant, attorney, a friend typing it), based only on the information you gave -- does not change the answer if you typed it yourself but someone helped you understand the questions.

data_assinatura.label: Date of Signature (filled in on the day of filing, MM/DD/YYYY)

int_organizacao.label: Interpreter — Business or Organization Name (if any)

int_end_codigo_postal.label: Interpreter — Postal Code (if outside the U.S.)

prep_organizacao.label: Preparer — Business or Organization Name (if any)

prep_end_codigo_postal.label: Preparer — Postal Code (if outside the U.S.)
